evidence.title: Incident report IR-2005-011
evidence.claim: In 2005, a customer reported a TL-5 can lid blowing off due to CO2 production from moisture reacting with isocyanate.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2002-005
evidence.claim: In 2002, pre-drying empty cans for 2 hours at 60 °C in oven OV-1 was introduced due to moisture in cans stored outdoors.
evidence.quote: Change: pre-dry all empty cans for 2 h at 60 °C in oven OV-1 before filling. Reason: moisture in cans stored outdoors

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-2002-008
evidence.claim: In 2002, condensation was found in empty cans from Latte Brunetti stored outdoors, causing rust spots and gelled skins in TL-5.
evidence.quote: rust spots and gelled skins inside cans. Empty cans from Latte Brunetti are stored outdoors under a tarpaulin; condensation found inside.

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2017-004 - Imballaggi Corvino S.r.l.
evidence.claim: In 2017, Imballaggi Corvino replaced Latte Brunetti; cans are now shrink-wrapped with desiccants and stored indoors, with no detectable moisture.

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-2001-019
evidence.claim: In 2001, TL-5 cans bulged at a customer site because isocyanate reacted with water in Polyol PS-400.
evidence.quote: cans bulging at a customer (domed lids). Carbon dioxide formed by the reaction of isocyanate with water.

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2016-005 - Nordpol Chemicals AB, NP-310 Dry
evidence.claim: In 2016, Nordpol Chemicals NP-310 Dry replaced Polioli Sereni PS-400 for TL-5, featuring a maximum water content of 0.03%.
evidence.quote: Replaces Polioli Sereni PS-400 for TL-5.

verdict.process_name: TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K moisture-cure polyurethane)
verdict.instruction: Pre-dry empty 5 L cans in oven OV-1 at 60 °C for 2 h.
verdict.reason: The step was introduced to remove moisture from cans supplied by Latte Brunetti and stored outdoors (E4, E5). Since 2017, the supplier was changed to Imballaggi Corvino, who provides shrink-wrapped cans with desiccants stored indoors with no detectable moisture (E6).

chain.claim: Pre-drying was introduced due to moisture in cans stored outdoors

dependencies.name: cans from Latte Brunetti stored outdoors

counter_evidence.claim: Customer reported can lid blowing off due to CO2 from moisture reacting with isocyanate
counter_evidence.resolution: The specific cause of moisture in cans (outdoor storage of Latte Brunetti cans) has been eliminated by the new supplier's indoor storage and packaging (E6).
